issues.description: The reference solution for Aufgabe 02 uses Gemeinde.schluessel = Freizeitpark.id as the join condition, but the problem context and schema imply that Freizeitpark should be linked to Gemeinde via a gemeindeschluessel column (e.g. Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel). Using Freizeitpark.id as the join key is an identifier mismatch that will produce incorrect joins or confusing results and misleads students about the correct foreign-key column to use.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution (and any guidance), use the correct foreign-key column name for the join. Replace WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Freizeitpark.id with WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel (or the actual column name used in the schema that references Gemeinde.schluessel). Update any explanatory text so students know which column is the foreign key.
